findings.mechanism: 03-errors-as-interface – broad exception handler swallows DB errors and returns empty list, causing silent success
findings.remediation: Remove the blanket except block and let the exception propagate (or raise an HTTPException 500) instead of returning an empty list
findings.arithmetic: When the database raises any exception, the except clause returns [], which the API layer serialises as a 200 OK with an empty list. Therefore under a DB outage the client receives a successful HTTP status code (≤299).
